d:
Enjoy The Evergreen Ondu Maathu Audio Song From The Classic Kannada Movie Keralida Simha, Featuring The Legendary Dr. Rajkumar And Saritha, With Music Composed By Sathyam. Relive The Golden Era Of Kannada Cinema With This Beautiful Old Kannada Song From MRT Music.
Kannada Old Songs, Hit Songs, And Movie Audio Tracks.
Directed by: Chi Dattaraj
Produced by: P. H. Ramarao
Written by: M. D. Sundar
Artist Name: Dr. Rajkumar, Saritha
Music Director: Sathyam
Cinematography: R. Madhusudan
